raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since the 2026-01-16 rollout, collector 'v2' writes txn_ts in UTC, while 'legacy' writes America/Chicago local time. The v2 rows are therefore 6 hours ahead (e.g. 12:03 UTC is 06:03 local). This pushes evening v2 transactions into the 00:00-06:00 window and into the next txn_date. The fix normalizes v2 timestamps to Chicago local time (UTC-6; all data is in January, so no DST) before deriving txn_date.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
